author: Good Enough
description:
During the Middle Ages, soup wasn't just food, it was often prescribed as medicine. Medieval healers believed different broths and herbal soups could restore the body's balance, fight illness, and help patients recover. 

Discover the unusual medical beliefs and treatments that shaped healthcare during the Middle Ages.
title: They Used Soup as Medicine 🍲😲 #history #medieval #facts #didyouknow
